BY PARENTS FOR PARENTS
Readmio is an app full of fairy tales that we have enriched with sounds. Just download the app, save a story to the library and start reading! You don’t have to worry about anything, just read at a regular speed and our application will listen to you and enhance your experience. That’s it.
